Do not really delete a project. Just tuck it away so it drops off my lists. Keep it off the

Note it when I do.

Do not really delete a project. Just tuck it away so it drops off my lists. Keep it off the
main project list and off the list on the client's page. I do not want to lose anything.
Note it when I do.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it

iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor

agent.result_text:
The test passes. The full-stack change is complete and verified.

## Summary

I implemented **archiving** for projects — a soft "tuck away" that keeps the data but drops the project off both lists, records an audit line, and can be revealed again.

**Database** (`V16__project_archived.sql`) — new Flyway migration adding an `archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` column to `project`, so existing and new projects start visible.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST):
- `Project` entity + `ProjectView` carry the `archived` flag (all three `ProjectView` call sites updated).
- New endpoint `POST /api/projects/archive` (`archive.POST.yml` → `ProjectsArchive`, body `ArchiveProject`): flags the project archived instead of deleting it, and records `PROJECT_ARCHIVED id=<id>` through the `Audit` service. `GET /api/projects` now returns the `archived` flag so the UI can filter.

**Front-end** (additive — new files, one necessary edit each to the list components that consume the shared key):
- `features/projects/archive.slot.tsx` — an "Archive" row action (`data-testid="project-archive-<id>"`) that POSTs and invalidates `['projects']`.
- `slots/defs/projectsToolbar.ts` + `features/projects/showArchived.slot.tsx` — a toolbar region and the "Show archived" toggle (`data-testid="projects-show-archived"`) owning the `showArchived` URL search param.
- `ProjectsPage` renders the toolbar and hides archived rows unless the toggle is on; `ClientProjectsPanel` always hides archived, keeping them off the client's page too. Both share the `['projects']` query key, so archiving refreshes everything.

`bin/e2e` build/start/test/stop passes:
```
✓ acceptance.spec.ts › archive a project › archiving hides the project but keeps it
  1 passed
```

Nothing is lost — an archived project is retained on the server, drops off the main list and the client's page, is noted in the audit log, and returns when archived projects are revealed.
